model.architecture: Liquid AI's hybrid text backbone (22 gated short-convolution blocks + 8 grouped-query attention layers, 128k vocab) with a SigLIP2 vision tower (27 layers, hidden 1152) and a pixel-unshuffle projector.

variants.quantization: text int4 blockwise-32 OCTAV linears, int8 embedding + lm_head; vision tower int8

recommended.reason: the Android path measured on a Pixel 8a (Tensor G3): 10.8 tok/s decode on gpu; the same phone's cpu row decodes 5.8 tok/s

the Android path verified on a Galaxy S26 (S4 gate 2026-08-25): full delegation (11135 ops across 12 subgraphs) and a correct answer to the probe; 27.0 tok/s decode, engine init 8.0 s, peak 1465 MB. No same-device CPU control was taken, so this is the verified choice for the class, not a measured win over CPU; the repo's LFM2.5-VL-3B_int8.litertlm decodes 20.23 tok/s on the same device and backend, so this file carries the class
card: iOS Metal fails at engine creation for this family, tracked upstream in [LiteRT-LM#3129](https://github.com/google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM/issues/3129) — use CPU on iOS

platform_notes: Context (KV cache) 4096 max; one image per prompt, resized to 512x512 -> 256 tokens, PNG/JPEG via --attachment.
--vision-backend cpu|gpu selects the vision encoder backend independently of the text backend; text-only prompts work without --attachment.
The text graph delegates fully on Android OpenCL (937/937 nodes, zero rejected ops).
Galaxy S26 GPU gate covers engine creation and the text path only (no image in the gate prompt); the vision path on the GPU is not measured there. XNNPACK takes 1 of 4 nodes in main.
All five image answers from both LiteRT variants are verbatim identical to the bf16 reference on both backends.

S4 GPU gate, 205-token benchmark, single run; full delegation (11135 ops across 12 subgraphs); generation gate answered the probe correctly. No same-device CPU control was taken, so this is a GPU speed, not a measured win over CPU.

known_issues: On litert-lm 0.16.0 and current main only the top quarter of the image reaches the model; captioning, colour questions and OCR of a large dominant subject work, but positional questions (locate, count, enumerate) come back wrong with no error.

Cause: a shrink-factor assumption in the runtime's vision path, reported upstream as LiteRT-LM#3246; affects every LFM2.5-VL bundle (2x2 pixel-unshuffle lives in the adapter, runtime assumes the encoder).
Band-ruler check (16 numbered bands, top to bottom): expected 1..16, actual '1 1 2 2 3 3 4 4 1'.
A repaired build exists (pooling moved into the exported encoder) but the published files were not replaced pending the upstream fix; open a discussion if needed.
iOS Metal (GPU) fails at engine creation for this family (LiteRT-LM#3129); use CPU on iOS.
The 5/5 image gate cannot separate 'resolved the image' from 'answered from priors': all fixtures sit below the top-quarter cut, and the 3B still scores 5/5 while seeing only the top quarter.
Text gate 7/8: the single miss (rhyme completion answered 'Purple.') is shared with the source model at greedy decoding, not a conversion artifact.
Android GPU path writes multi-GB compile caches next to the model by default; on a nearly-full device the cache write can fail mid-initialization — run with --disable_cache or free storage first.
